accumulation_fix: loss divided by actual number of microbatches in preplanned group; singleton tail divisor1
subset_pass: WER<=20%, loss<=50%initial, and >=10 percentage-point WER improvement; or initial/final WER both<=20% with no deterioration and loss halved
collapse_gate: from epoch6, two evaluations with TRAIN and DEV blank>=.995 or top-token fraction>=.98 and diversity<=3
selection: primary80 tuple(WER,CTC loss); strong27 descriptive only
credible_improvement: >=.005 absolute WER better than prior primary80 AND no failure of TRAIN screen; smaller gains descriptive
training_screen: selected fullTRAIN WER<=50%, diversity>=10, multi-token outputs>=25%
